paragraphs: In Vayikra Rabbah 11:8, he, Rabbi Shimon and Rabbi Reuven report in the name of R' Chanina. Hyman says the name should actually read R' Yose bar Bibi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The separately read Midrash Rabbah--TE 11:8 has full רבי for Yishmael bar Beivai, Shimon and Reuven, supporting those exact title occurrences and the Shimon initials expansion. Its Beivai spelling differs from supplied Bibi, and its Chanina is untitled; Hyman’s ר׳ חנינא remains R', without a full-title inference.

ובאמת צ״ל preserves Hyman’s assertive actually-should-read proposal of Yose rather than Yishmael; it does not replace the heading or erase the named witness’s Yishmael. Yose’s proposed title remains R'. No printed-page or correction-history proof follows from this digital paragraph.
